typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblSLACPemailAddressaudit_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		dateAction as timestamp,
		before as string,
		contraparty as string,
		action as string,
		After as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		dateAction as string,
		before as string,
		contraparty as string,
		action as string,
		after as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		dateAction,
		before,
		contraparty,
		action,
		after = After),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblSLACPemailAddressaudit_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblSLACPemailAddressaudit
